design_notes: References resolved outside generic reasoning engine.
Direct evidence declared in evidence_rules.json via direct=true.
Cause hierarchy declared in relationships.json via SUBTYPE_OF.
Receiver presence is carried into WIC facts so measured condenser-outlet subcooling without an applicable target remains unclassified and receiver-aware.
Plausible subtype hypotheses remain generalized to their broad parent until localized/direct evidence supports the subtype.

Gold-standard validation expectations are derived from manufacturer/component literature before comparison with Brain output; regression pass counts are not treated as proof of diagnostic correctness.

Field guidance is structured separately from diagnosis: direct observations map to why-it-matters, next physical check, exact UI recording path where available, follow-up branch, and repair verification.
